ex.en: Are you in a hurry, or should we grab a coffee?

ex.es: Mi esposo siempre tiene prisa en las mañanas.
ex.en: My husband is always in a hurry in the mornings.

ex.es: Mi esposo manejó todo el camino a Florida.
ex.en: My husband drove the whole way to Florida.
Don't drive; you had two beers.

ex.es: Mientras esperaba el autobús, me llamó mi mamá.
ex.en: While I was waiting for the bus, my mom called me.

ex.es: Mi hijo hace la tarea mientras yo preparo la cena.
ex.en: My son does his homework while I make dinner.

notes: Removed a sentence duplicated from VC1-39 (manejar); fixed an illogical 'tener prisa' exchange; replaced an ambiguous imperfect/imperfect 'mientras' sentence. Rest accurate, natural, Latin American register.
